description: Gordiana wears a purple floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and gold geometric woven borders around the neckline, bodice, cuffs, centre and hem. Round shoulder brooches and a belt of linked round decorated medallions secure the layers. A pale ivory fringed wrap with purple-gold borders rests around her forearms. An ivory underdress and closed purple-brown shoes with gold motifs show at the lower opening. A gold bracelet and finger ring are visible. Her loose dark rear hair gathering is uncovered.
